extracted text: The paper studies 7N01-T4 aluminum alloy and its friction stir welding (FSW) joints. The tensile strength and elongation of 7N01-T4 aluminum alloy FSW joint are 379 MPa and 7.9%, up to 84.2% and 52% of the base material, respectively. The paper also mentions that when using A-PFFSR process at rotational velocity of 1600 rpm and plunge speed of 2 mm/min, the tensile strength and elongation of the repaired joint reach 311.1 MPa and 7.6%, equivalent to 82.1% and 95.8% of the defect-free FSW joint.
